cases.sentence: Елисей сказал женщине, уходи с семьей и поселись, где сможешь, потому что Господь навел на страну ___.
cases.translation: Elisha said to the woman, 'Arise, and go, you and your household, for the Lord has called for a famine.'
cases.explain: The accusative case is used for the direct object of the verb 'навел' (called for).

cases.sentence: Она вернулась из земли филистимлян и пошла к ___ просить о своем доме.
cases.translation: She came to the king to beg him for her house and her land.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Царь был в беседе с Геезием, слугой Божьего ___, и сказал ему.
cases.translation: The king was speaking with Gehazi, the servant of the man of God.
cases.explain: The genitive case shows possession — the servant of the man of God.

cases.sentence: Он назначил чиновника рассмотреть ее дело и верни ей все доходы от ее ___, которые были получены.
cases.translation: The king appointed an officer to restore all the fruits of her field.
cases.explain: The genitive case is used with the preposition 'от' (from) to show origin.

cases.sentence: Елисей пришел в Дамас, когда Винода царь Арама был болен. Хазаил пошел встречать Елисея, взяв с собой в дар лучших товаров на сорок верблюжьих поклаж ___.
cases.translation: Hazael went to meet Elisha, taking forty camels' burden of the best goods of Damascus.
cases.explain: The genitive case is used after numbers in expressions with 'поклаж' (loads).

cases.sentence: Твой ___ Винодат, царь Арама, послал меня спросить, выздоровею ли я от этой болезни.
cases.translation: Your son Benhadad, king of Syria, sent me to inquire whether I will recover from this illness.
cases.explain: The noun is the subject of the verb 'послал' (sent) and stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Хазаил ушел от Елисея и вернулся к своему ___.
cases.translation: He departed from Elisha and came to his master.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: На следующий день он взял одеяло, намочил его ___, накрыл им лицо царя, и тот умер.
cases.translation: On the next day, he took a thick cloth, dipped it in water, and spread it on his face, so that he died.
cases.explain: The instrumental case is used after the verb 'намочил' (dipped) to show what something is wet with.

reading.ru: Елисей сказал женщине сына, который он воскресил, «Уходи с семьей и поселись, где сможешь, потому что Господь навел на страну голод, который будет длиться семь лет».
reading.question: What did Elisha tell the Shunammite woman about the coming judgment?
options: A plague would come to the land
A famine would come to the land for seven years
The king would take away her house
reading.correct: A famine would come to the land for seven years
reading.explain: Elisha told her 'Господь навел на страну голод, который будет длиться семь лет' — the Lord has called a famine that will last seven years.

reading.ru: Через семь лет она вернулась из земли филистимлян и пошла к царю просить о своем доме и земле.
reading.question: Where did the woman go to live during the famine, and how long did she stay there?
options: In the land of the Philistines for seven years
reading.correct: In the land of the Philistines for seven years
reading.explain: The text states 'семь лет жила в земле филистимлян' — she lived in the land of the Philistines for seven years.

reading.ru: Царь расспросил женщину, и она рассказала ему. Тогда он назначил чиновника рассмотреть ее дело, сказав ему, «Верни ей все, что у нее было, а также все доходы от ее земли».
reading.question: How did the king of Israel restore the woman's property?
options: He gave her money as compensation
He appointed an officer to restore all that was hers and all the fruits of her land
He forced the Philistines to return it
He gave her new property in Jerusalem
reading.correct: He appointed an officer to restore all that was hers and all the fruits of her land
reading.explain: The king appointed a chiefofficer and said 'Верни ей все, что у нее было, а также все доходы от ее земли' — restore all she had and the land's fruits.

reading.ru: Елисей сказал, «Иди и скажи ему, ты обязательно выздоровеешь, но Господь открыл мне, что на самом деле он умрет».
reading.question: What contradiction did Elisha make regarding King Benhadad's recovery?
options: He said he would recover but the Lord showed him he would die
He said he would get worse
He said recovery would be slow
He said another man would become king
reading.correct: He said he would recover but the Lord showed him he would die
reading.explain: Elisha told Hazael to say the king would recover, but 'Господь открыл мне, что на самом деле он умрет' — the Lord showed him he would surely die.

reading.ru: Потому что я знаю, какое зло ты причинишь израилетянам. Ты сожжешь их крепости, юношей их убьешь мечом, разобьешь их младенцев о землю и порубишь их беременных женщин.
reading.question: What specific evils did Elisha say Hazael would inflict upon Israel?
options: He would burn their fortresses, kill their young men with the sword, dash their babies to the ground, and rip up their pregnant women
He would take their king captive
reading.correct: He would burn their fortresses, kill their young men with the sword, dash their babies to the ground, and rip up their pregnant women
reading.explain: Elisha described these specific acts of violence Hazael would commit against Israel.

reading.ru: На следующий день он взял одеяло, намочил его водой, накрыл им лицо царя, и тот умер. А Хазаил стал царем вместо него.
reading.question: How did Hazael bring about King Benhadad's death?
options: He took a cloth, dipped it in water, covered the king's face with it, and he died
He smothered him with a pillow
He stabbed him with a sword
reading.correct: He took a cloth, dipped it in water, covered the king's face with it, and he died
reading.explain: The text states 'он взял одеяло, намочил его водой, накрыл им лицо царя, и тот умер' — he covered the king's face with a wet cloth and he died.
